# Call Center Data Integrations

Your contact center's sources, unified into one performance model.

[Request a Demo](https://www.amplifai.com/schedule-demo) [Talk to an integration expert](https://www.amplifai.com/integrations#integration-enquiry)

## One data foundation

Any data, from any source, on one AmplifAI foundation.

Structured and unstructured, cloud and on-premise, bought and homegrown. AmplifAI normalises what each system means before it scores anything, so a metric reads the same whichever platform produced it.

## Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) Integrations

### What if our platform is not on the list?

The list is not exhaustive. AmplifAI ingests from APIs, scheduled exports and direct database connections, so a homegrown or niche system is usually a question of format rather than feasibility. Tell us what you run and we will show you how it connects.

### How long does an integration take to stand up?

Standard connectors to the platforms above are configuration rather than development. Most contact centers are live on their core sources in weeks, not quarters, and additional sources are added without disturbing the ones already running.

### Do our call recordings have to leave our environment?

No. AmplifAI can score interactions without taking custody of your recordings, and PII is redacted automatically. The security and compliance detail is on the trust page.

### Does AmplifAI replace our CCaaS, CRM or WFM platform?

No. AmplifAI is deliberately agnostic and sits above those systems. It reads what they produce and turns it into the next best action for each role, which is why it is additive to the stack rather than a competitor inside it.
